subject: Re: [GGIR] part 4 output missing after bring in sleep log

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] part 4 output missing after bring in sleep log
parts:
Dear Jaslie,

  • Are you able to get the full part4 report as stored in the results/QC subfolder?
  • If yes, then this should clarify which 'guider' is used for every night. If none of the nights indicates sleeplog then that indicates that sleeplog could not be used. For example, because it was not in the expected format. If this is the case then check that IDs in sleeplog match IDs as extracted by GGIR in part2_summary.csv. Further, have another look at vignette documentation on the format of sleeplog. Also check that date in sleeplog matches data range of acc recordings.
  • If not, are you able to generate output when you do not provide the sleeplog?

Best,
Vincent

Thank you for your time.

Kind Regards,

messages.author: 06331e827f65a896
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] part 4 output missing after bring in sleep log
parts:
Hi Vincent,

Thank you for getting back to me. My codes are working with the log now. Just to share what I did to make the log work...
1. I changed idloc=2, because I realised my cwa file had "_" in them. I also changed my sleep log's ID to match them.
2. I re-saved my log into .csv format.
Additionally, I made several minor changes to my sleep log after reading other users' older conversations in this group, and they were very helpful.

Thanks again.

Jaslie
